title: SimCRAFT: Distilling Remote Sensing Agents via Synthetic Trajectories and Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2608.30277v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The unprecedented surge in Earth observation data volume and diversity has exposed a critical bottleneck for traditional manual workflows, catalyzing the emergence of Remote Sensing (RS) Agents. However, the practical deployment of these advanced agents is severely hindered by their heavy reliance on large-scale general-purpose LLMs, which lack deep domain expertise and impose prohibitive infrastructure demands. To resolve this, we propose SimCRAFT, a model-agnostic framework that distills sophisticated RS orchestration capabilities into a compact 7B-scale model. Addressing data scarcity, we first pair a multiagent synthesis engine with a Mock Execution Engine that checks schema correctness, inter-tool dependencies, and sensor/tool compatibility, producing SimRS-14k, a large-scale, constraint-validated workflow planning corpus. Second, we propose Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning (CRAFT) that finetunes the model to reason analog

translated_title: SimCRAFT：通过合成轨迹与上下文检索增强微调蒸馏遥感智能体
translated_abstract: 地球观测数据量和多样性的空前激增暴露了传统人工工作流程的关键瓶颈，催生了遥感智能体的出现。然而，这些先进智能体的实际部署受到严重阻碍，因为它们严重依赖大规模通用大语言模型（LLM），而这些模型缺乏深入的领域专业知识，并对基础设施提出了极高的要求。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SimCRAFT，这是一个与模型无关的框架，能够将复杂的遥感编排能力蒸馏到一个紧凑的70亿参数规模模型中。针对数据稀缺问题，我们首先将多智能体合成引擎与模拟执行引擎相配对，该引擎可检查模式正确性、工具间依赖关系以及传感器/工具兼容性，从而生成了SimRS-14k——一个大规模、经约束验证的工作流规划语料库。其次，我们提出了上下文检索增强微调（CRAFT），通过微调使模型能够进行类比推理……
tldr: 提出了SimCRAFT框架，通过多智能体合成引擎生成大规模约束验证的工作流规划语料库SimRS-14k，并结合上下文检索增强微调（CRAFT），将复杂的遥感智能体编排能力蒸馏到紧凑的7B规模模型中。
en_tdlr: SimCRAFT distills sophisticated remote sensing agent orchestration capabilities into a compact 7B-scale model by generating a large-scale constraint-validated workflow planning corpus (SimRS-14k) through a multiagent synthesis engine and employing Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning (CRAFT).
